option_relations.rationale: Ventricular tachycardia is a component of the dual tachycardia but not the complete diagnosis.
The option specifies atrial flutter and accelerated idioventricular rhythm, which are not directly supported by the vignette's findings of atrial tachycardia and slow ventricular tachycardia.
Atrial tachycardia is only one component of the dual tachycardia confirmed by the electrophysiology study.

The option 'Dual tachyarrhythmias (atrial tachycardia plus slow ventricular tachycardia)' is clinically equivalent to the leaf 'Dual tachycardia (atrial tachycardia plus slow ventricular tachycardia)' as both describe the same condition confirmed by the electrophysiology study.
